claims.text: Ongoing mgmt, ⍉struct or ischemic Hdz, ablation ⍉an option, and BB, diltiazem or verapamil ineffective or CI: flecainide or propafenone = reasonable.
claims.quote: Flecainide or propafenone is reasonable for ongoing management in patients without structural heart disease or ischemic heart disease who have AVNRT and are not candidates for, or prefer not to undergo, catheter ablation and in whom beta blockers, diltiazem, or verapamil are ineffective or contraindicated.
